description: This file defines the MenuItemAPI class, an API endpoint for retrieving dynamic menu items for a mobile application within the OrangeHRM system. It consolidates different menu options based on user roles and enabled modules such as 'leave' and 'time'. It provides a method to fetch menu items, including visibility logic for ESS users, and exposes relevant metadata about leave and timesheet periods.

classes.name: MenuItemAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint to retrieve mobile menu items based on user role and module statuses, including methods for fetching menu options and relevant metadata.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the list of available menu items for the authenticated user, considering role, active modules, and configuration settings.
